Container.Name: movienight-transfer
Container.Overview: MovieNight Transfer Engine for downloading and managing torrents.

Config.Name: State Path
Config.Description: Path to transfer engine state files (resume data)

Config.Name: Quarantine Path
Config.Description: Path for quarantined files. The ONLY path the engine writes to.

Config.Name: Engine Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret authenticating every call to the transfer engine, REQUIRED. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. It must match the value in the movienight template.

Config.Name: Transfer Port
Config.Description: Port of the transfer engine API

Config.Name: Quarantine Path (env)
Config.Description: Internal path of the quarantine inside the container

Config.Name: State File
Config.Description: Internal path of the resume state file inside the container

Config.Name: Exploration Max Bytes
Config.Description: Byte budget of a metadata exploration (2 Mio by default)

Config.Name: Exploration Max Seconds
Config.Description: Time budget of a metadata exploration, in seconds

Config.Name: Watchdog Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between two lease expiry checks

Config.Name: Checkpoint Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between two durable state checkpoints

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID of the container user. Match the owner of the state and quarantine paths.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID of the container user. Match the group of the state and quarantine paths.
